# attested in source

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestedInSource`](gmeow-attestedInSource.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedInSource>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The bibliographic or documentary source in which the attested form was observed. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an attestation may be supported by multiple sources, and competing source attributions coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Targets a [`CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) (the retired Source Kind was greenfield-refactored in source/claim refactor).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attestedInSource`](gmeow-attestedInSource.md) from [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md), [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to name the bibliographic or documentary source — a [`CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) — in which the form was observed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single source (it is non-functional; an attestation may cite several) and avoid naming the physical artifact here (that is [`gmeow:attestedOnCarrier`](gmeow-attestedOnCarrier.md)) or the corpus/community context ([`gmeow:attestedInContext`](gmeow-attestedInContext.md)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:attestedInSource`](gmeow-attestedInSource.md) at one or more [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) sources (required by the someValuesFrom axiom); competing source attributions coexist.
